note: Owner-editable script. Every text carries en + zh-Hans. Schema: docs/release/story-content.md

npc.fallbackGreeting.en: Hi! Tap a question below or type your own.
npc.fallbackGreeting.zh-Hans: 你好，想了解什么？点下面的问题或直接输入。

guide.quiet.en: Keep walking. New notes appear here as places confirm.
guide.quiet.zh-Hans: 继续走走，确认到达的地点会在这里留下提示。

guide.footprint.en: The edge of your last walk is still here, and nearby areas are not lit yet.
guide.footprint.zh-Hans: 上次的足迹边缘仍留在这里；附近还有尚未点亮的区域。

text.en: Walk at your own pace; the map lights up wherever you go.
text.zh-Hans: 按自己的节奏走，走到哪里，地图就亮到哪里。

text.en: It is raining. Arcades and covered lanes still count as walked.
text.zh-Hans: 下雨了，骑楼和有顶的小巷也算走过。

text.en: Snow on the ground. Watch your step near stairs and bridges.
text.zh-Hans: 地上有雪，走台阶和桥面时留意脚下。

text.en: It is hot out. Shade and water first; the map will wait.
text.zh-Hans: 天气很热，先找阴凉、补水，地图不会跑。

text.en: Night walk. Stay on lit streets.
text.zh-Hans: 夜间漫游，尽量走有灯的街道。

text.en: Each stop opens when you arrive. Read the task card before you start.
text.zh-Hans: 每一站到达后开启，开始前先读一遍任务卡。

text.en: Stuck? The hint ladder on the task opens one step at a time.
text.zh-Hans: 卡住了？任务上的提示会一层一层打开。

text.en: This stop has a shop guide. Ask it about the place.
text.zh-Hans: 这一站有店铺向导，可以问问它这家店的事。

text.en: Rain on the route. Indoor stops first is fine.
text.zh-Hans: 路上有雨，可以先去室内的站点。
